name: Basil Pesto-White Bean Polenta Stacks with Pepper & Artichoke Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 230°C (450°F). Coat two large baking sheet pans with a thin layer of oil.
Slice polenta crosswise into ½-inch thick rounds. Divide between the baking sheets, arranging the slices in a single layer.
Place polenta in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) while you prepare the topping.
Drain and rinse beans. Place in a large bowl along with pesto, salt, and pepper; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans cannellini (white kidney) beans
¾ cup basil pesto
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Remove baking sheets from the oven. Spoon the bean topping over the polenta slices, then top with cheese. (Wipe bowl clean with paper towels and reserve for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Return baking sheets to the oven and bake until polenta stacks are warmed through and cheese is melted, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry spring mix (skip if it came pre-washed). Place in the reserved bowl along with the carrots.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: Drain and roughly chop artichokes and roasted peppers. Add both to the bowl with the mixed greens, along with the dressing, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated
1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers
⅓ cup Italian salad dressing

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide polenta stacks and salad between plates. Enjoy!
